page.overview:
Who is Adhira Deol?

Adhira got very disconcerted with her son wondering why he had chosen the Inhumans over his own family, but Dinesh assured his mother and father that the Terrigen Mist only revealed his true self. After an encounter with Banyan, Adhira became surprised after Dinesh decided to stay in India after all.
